name: skill-smith
description: A Skill creation coach that turns repetitive workflows into tested, review-passed Skill packages: scope discovery, requirement confirmation, generation, hands-on testing, and standards-based review.

displayDescription.en: Turns repetitive workflows into working Skills: scope discovery, requirement confirmation, generation, hands-on testing, and standards-based review.
displayDescription.zh: 陪制作者把重复工作流做成可用的 Skill：挖掘场景、确认需求、生成制作、实测验证、按标准审查打分。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我每次写周报都要重新教 AI 我们团队的格式，能做成 Skill 吗
defaultInitPrompt.en: I re-teach AI our team report format every week. Can this become a Skill?
